name: North University of China
aliases: Taihang Industrial School, North China Vocational School of Ordnance
supervisors: Shanxi Provincial Government (co-built with MIIT and SASTIND)

evidence.summary: NUC describes itself as co-built by the Shanxi provincial government with the industry ministry (MIIT) and the defence-industry regulator SASTIND.

Its list of key laboratories names a national defence key discipline laboratory for underground target damage technology, and its 2021 profile says its national-level defence research platforms include a national defence science and technology key laboratory as well as key discipline laboratories.
items: Underground Target Damage Technology National Defence Key Discipline Laboratory (地下目标毁伤技术国防重点学科实验室)

evidence.summary: Its 2021 profile reports five defence-specialty disciplines (国防特色学科) designated by SASTIND for 2016–2020.

It hosts a national defence science and technology innovation centre and a national defence research and application centre for precision plastic forming technology, and says its research results are used in major weapon programmes as well as crewed spaceflight and lunar exploration.

Founded in 1941 by the Eighth Route Army headquarters as the Communist forces’ first ordnance school, it came under the National Defence Science and Technology Commission in 1963 and the state ordnance group China North Industries Corporation in 1993, and has been run jointly by the central government and Shanxi since 1999.
